answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in dawn, expire in garden, and horizon lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 66 aliases hence needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3651 identities would post 4685 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
